title: Rewrite BikeGeometryLibraryFields.tsx as 3-phase chip selector with live geometry preview
proof: Rewrote `src/components/bikes/BikeGeometryLibraryFields.tsx` as a 3-phase brand/model/size chip selector with live geometry preview and single custom fallback disclosure; verified with `npx tsc --noEmit`.
salientSummary: Removed the autocomplete heuristics and toggle-based fallback UX in favor of a phased chip selector that preserves the existing bike form state machine.
